name: keeps clipped edge windows instead of dropping them
input: a 2 by 3 matrix, 2 by 2 kernel, unit stride

name: uses the first row-major coordinate for tied maxima
input: a window with equal maximum values
test:
pooled, locations = max_pool_with_locations([[5, 1], [5, 0]], 2, 2, 1, 1)
assert pooled[0][0] == 5
assert locations[0][0] == (0, 0)

name: supports negative values and clipped non-overlapping windows
input: a 3 by 3 matrix with a 2 by 2 kernel and stride two

name: pools channel-first tensors independently
test:
pooled, locations = max_pool_with_locations([[[1, 8], [3, 4]], [[9, 2], [9, 0]]], 2, 2, 2, 2, is_tensor=True)
assert pooled == [[[8]], [[9]]]
assert locations == [[[(0, 0, 1)]], [[(1, 0, 0)]]]
